title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: Andrew Hunt, David Thomas
notes: Classic software engineering book; good for developers of all levels.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
notes: Essential reading on writing maintainable code.

title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides
notes: Also known as the 'Gang of Four' book.

title: Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code
author: Martin Fowler
notes: Key patterns for safe refactoring techniques.

title: You Don't Know JS: Scope & Closures
author: Kyle Simpson
notes: Part of a series explaining JavaScript in depth.

title: Introduction to Algorithms
author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, Clifford Stein

title: JavaScript: The Good Parts
author: Douglas Crockford
notes: Concise insight into the strengths of JavaScript.

title: Domain-Driven Design: Tackling Complexity in the Heart of Software

title: Working Effectively with Legacy Code
